items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Receives diagnosis, will be monitored
items.text:
Mahomes was diagnosed with an "elbow strain/sprain" on his throwing arm following an MRI on Sunday, and he'll "continue to be monitored" leading up to the Chiefs' Week 10 game in Atlanta, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Pregame back spasms lead to Week 9 absence
items.text:
McConkey was active but didn't play any snaps in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans after experiencing back spasms during pregame workouts, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Uncertain to play Week 10
items.text:
Packers head coach Matt LaFleur acknowledged after Sunday's 45-27 win over the Patriots that Jacobs' (finger) availability for the team's Week 10 matchup with the Vikings is uncertain, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports. "Hopefully we can do something to allow him to go out there," LaFleur said of Jacobs. "But he was just having a hard time gripping the ball."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jake Ferguson: Headed for imaging on knee
items.text:
Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said after Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts that Ferguson will undergo imaging on his knee Monday, the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jessie Bates: Bound for Jacksonville
items.text:
The Jaguars acquired Bates from the Falcons on Monday in exchange for a 2027 second-round draft pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
